title: Negative refraction with low absorption using EIT in a four-level left-handed atomic system
summary: We suggest a scheme for obtaining negative refraction with low absorption in a left-handed atomic system.Under the the appropriate conditions,the atomic system displays negative refraction with negative permittivity and permeability(Left-handedness)in a common frequency range,simultaneously.And the imaginary parts of permittivity and permeability show transparently propagate in the same frequency range.Finally,the negative refraction show low absorption due to the EIT effect,and the figure of merit demonstrated this in this resonant atomic system.
